principle: Bir özellik yayını açmak için zorunlu değilse MVP’ye eklenmeyecek.
method: One warm-up followed by ten measured generations per profile; identical actions and deterministic seeds. Visual labels were assigned by direct human-readable inspection of the generated frames.

decision.reason: It doubled the clearly readable action count in the fixed set while adding only about 0.33 seconds to warm-generation G95. No OOM occurred. The 7.56 GiB peak leaves little GPU headroom, so no concurrent GPU model may run during the MVP stream.
